milestoneContract.title: V6 PKG-R2 sealed trust root and release-candidate truth
milestoneContract.objective: Run the Founder-authorized final trust-root reseal with the unchanged generator after every protected edit, move the current-truth documents to the release-candidate values required by the reviewed SEALED mode, and persist the PKG-H and PKG-R1 review records, so that the release ZIP can be built from exactly this reviewed commit.
requirements: [V6-PKG-R2-RELEASE-CANDIDATE-RESEAL-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.decision] PKG_R_APPROVED (reseal authority) + PKGR_RELEASE_MODE_APPROVED (release-candidate document values)

[V6-PKG-R2-RELEASE-CANDIDATE-RESEAL-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.rule] [PKG-R] Paketleme paketi + reseal yetkisi: yeni protected release-packaging paketi (SHA256SUMS üreticisi, deterministik ZIP, mevcut verify-artifact ile fresh-extract doğrulaması) ve bu paket içinde maintainer-only generate-trust-root.mjs final reseal'ini çalıştırma yetkisi; release imzası Founder'ın harici anahtarında kalır; Codex review otomatik. [Mühürlü mod] paste4d'ye açık ve fail-closed bir SEALED modu eklenir. Mod yalnız manifest SEALED iken devreye girer; trust root ve SHA256SUMS o anda yeniden doğrulanır, doğrulamadan geçmeyen FAIL olur. İmza artifact dışında (detached) kalır. Phase0=PENDING ve SOURCE_LEVEL_CLOSURE=false zorunlu kalır. paste4c ve belgeler PASS demeyen release-candidate değerleri alır (SEALED_RELEASE_CANDIDATE, EXTERNAL_DETACHED_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED). Mühürlü durum review edilmiş bir commit olur ve ZIP tam o commit'ten üretilir. Adversarial testler eklenir, Codex review otomatik yapılır.

[V6-PKG-R2-RELEASE-CANDIDATE-RESEAL-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.protectedFiles] config/trust-root-manifest.json (regenerated by scripts/generate-trust-root.mjs, unmodified generator), CANONICAL-STATUS.md

[V6-PKG-R2-RELEASE-CANDIDATE-RESEAL-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.constraint] Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; UNKNOWN, NOT_TESTED, BLOCKED or FAIL are never converted to PASS/CLEAN without real evidence; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11 in SEALED mode, and the checkpoint records the measured validation environment.

config/trust-root-manifest.json is exactly what the unchanged scripts/generate-trust-root.mjs produces for the reviewed tree: sealStatus SEALED, every protected file covered with its committed hash, and scripts/verify-trust-root.mjs passes on a clean checkout of the reviewed commit.

The current-truth documents use only the release-candidate values (SEALED_RELEASE_CANDIDATE, PACKAGING_STAGE_OUTSIDE_GIT, EXTERNAL_DETACHED_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED, ZERO_OPEN_P0P1P2_PENDING_PACKAGING_SIGNATURE_AND_TARGET_PHASE0, RELEASE_PACKAGING_SIGNATURE_THEN_TARGET_MACHINE_PHASE0), never claim PASS for SHA256SUMS, ZIP, signature or Phase0, keep SOURCE_LEVEL_CLOSURE false and TARGET_MACHINE_PHASE0 PENDING, and state only facts supported by committed checkpoints and review records.

The documented next order is consistent with the reviewed release tools: git archive export of this commit, SHA256SUMS, deterministic ZIP, fresh-extract verification, Founder detached signature outside the artifact, then install.ps1 Phase0.

Every added audit/reviews record is internally consistent: reviewResultText hashes to reviewResultSha256, frozenBundle hashes with stableStringify to bundleDigest, and the recorded result matches the reviewer output and governed evaluation.
No validator, script, policy or test changes in this package; the only protected changes are the regenerated manifest and CANONICAL-STATUS.md.

release-candidate document value that states PASS/DONE for SHA256SUMS, ZIP, signature or Phase0
